auditFocus: reactivity lost by destructuring a reactive()/props object instead of using refs, toRefs, or (Vue 3.5+) defineProps destructuring
a watch/watchEffect with a missing or wrong dependency, or one left running past the component's lifecycle with no cleanup
props or emitted events with no type-based defineProps<T>()/defineEmits<T>() declaration, or a mutated prop instead of emitting a change
v-html rendering unsanitized or user-controlled content
a Pinia store action mutating another store's state directly instead of calling its own actions, or state read outside a component/setup reactivity scope
a v-for list with no stable :key, or :key bound to the array index where the list can reorder
buildCommands: the project's type-check script (vue-tsc --noEmit or its package.json equivalent)
the project's lint script (eslint with eslint-plugin-vue enabled)
the project's test script (Vitest run of Vue Test Utils suites)
the project's build (vite build, or the framework's own production build)
fixGuardrails: never disable or downgrade an eslint-plugin-vue rule to silence a warning
never cast a component's props, emits, or template expression to any to satisfy vue-tsc
never delete or loosen a failing assertion in a Vue Test Utils test to make it pass
never mutate a prop in place as a build-fix instead of emitting an update event
